title: A Bifidelity Proximal Quasi-Newton Method for Dense Rigid Body Suspension Collision Resolution
summary: Direct numerical simulation of dense rigid body suspensions poses significant computational challenges. A popular approach to resolve collisions necessitates solving a linear complementary problem (LCP) per time step. Each matrix vector product (MVP) inside the LCP requires solving an expensive partial differential equation. In this work, we show the LCP can be solved efficiently, often in only three to four MVPs.
